description_zh: 调用ModifyCdnDomain修改加速域名基础信息
name: ModifyCdnDomain

parameters.help_en: The accelerated domain name. You can specify only one domain name in each request
parameters.help_zh: 加速域名，仅支持修改单个域名
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The information about the addresses of origin servers.

Do not set Sources and TopLevelDomain at the same time. If you set Sources and TopLevelDomain at the same time, TopLevelDomain does not take effect
parameters.help_zh:
回源地址列表。

不支持同时传入Sources和TopLevelDomain参数，如果您同时传入Sources和TopLevelDomain参数，TopLevelDomain将不生效
parameters.name: sources

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The root domain. To add a root domain name, you must be added to the whitelist specified by the CDN_TOP_LEVEL_DOMAIN_GREY_USER_LIST parameter.

Do not set Sources and TopLevelDomain at the same time. If you set Sources and TopLevelDomain at the same time, TopLevelDomain does not take effect
parameters.help_zh:
顶级接入域。只有白名单用户CDN_TOP_LEVEL_DOMAIN_GREY_USER_LIST设置才有效。

不支持同时传入Sources和TopLevelDomain参数，如果您同时传入Sources和TopLevelDomain参数，TopLevelDomain将不生效
parameters.name: top_level_domain
